race.comment: I AM A WINNER (7) looks well placed to turn two narrow seconds this campaign into a win. Meets a few of these better at the weights after going close at Gatton and should be nearing a peak effort third-up. IGOTMYMINDONYOU (4) also has to be taken seriously after putting two on the bounce, most recently beating SCARTOON at Toowoomba. Is sure to be very competitive again. SCARTOON (9) is also hard to dismiss with good form around those already mentioned. Can turn the tables with a pull at the weights. BELLE AFFAIR (5) returns for the Murphy camp and brings different formlines, solid ones nevertheless. Is drawn to advantage and should be in this for a long way.
